note: Everything here is provisional. Canon is never minted in a concept register; the implementation audit censuses Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md and adjudicates exact ids.

flags.note: Sheaf routes every navigation through PM2.route.go with a dest object; the canon family should keep dest-object payloads ({route,cat,sub,managerId,objectId,tab,settingId}) rather than per-destination ids.
One-level-out (crumb Back / Escape rung 3). May alias an existing cmd.settings.back if the census finds one; do not mint twice.
Grouped top-tab selection (9 tabs over 12 categories). Payload is the category id, not the tab index — the lens keeps both member categories addressable.
Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses the persistent field; census against the existing search command family before minting.
The copy transaction maps 1:1 onto PM2.copy preview/apply/rollback; if the canon already carries settings-transfer ids, alias instead of minting.

families_exercised_note: navigation (tab row, category lens, subgroup sub-tabs, crumb pile, More menu, escape ladder — all via PM2.route.go); values (toggle/select/radio/multiselect/number/slider/text edits through store.setValue with inline validation errors); providers (roster > detail tabs, installation select/update/repair triggers, explicit Cursor CLI setup); copy_transaction (preview/apply/rollback with staged ops and receipts); search (dropdown pick by rid, focus-param landing, back-restores-query).
